svg.text: line; M16 gland 16 hole at 38 right.

svg.text: Tape the face, pilot drill 3 slowly with wood behind, open out with

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: a step drill. No solvents: polycarbonate crazes. Deburr.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check each size against the part's datasheet before the last step.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit the four lugs to the back corners as the lug kit's maker says.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: no crack runs out of any hole under a bright lamp.
